fieldValues.title: Negative test for check-programme-conformance.mjs, plus a base-branch gate fix
fieldValues.summary: Added the missing negative test for check-programme-conformance.mjs's two assertions (srs#667), and while validating this unit's own gates, found and fixed a stale commit-pinned allowlist entry that was failing validate-all.mjs and check-release-drift.mjs on a bare origin/master checkout (srs#668).
fieldValues.body:
srs#667: added a root-override argument to check-programme-conformance.mjs (mirroring every sibling check-*-cell.mjs), and a new tests/guards/run.mjs case copying the real programme/ tree, breaking each of the check's two assertions in turn (emptied .srs marker; a record with a dangling typeId reference), asserting red with the offending message, then restoring and asserting green.

srs#668: scripts/versioning-cell-allowlist.json's one entry pinned its violation by commit SHA (fromCommit 3553f2ac, toCommit 72c5d2b7). Master's history was rewritten after those commits were made: 3553f2ac no longer exists as a git object, and 72c5d2b7 is no longer an ancestor of origin/master, even though its tree content is present in the live corpus. check-versioning-cell.mjs could no longer observe the transition, so the entry stopped matching anything and both required gates failed on a bare master checkout. Fixed by shrinking the allowlist to entries: [], per the check's own documented remedy. srs#658 (the underlying semantic gap — no per-field version override in the metamodel generator) stays open.
